abstract: Serum levels of human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG), specific pregnancy protein (SP1), and hPL were measured in 675 samples from women with uneventful pregnancy, and serially from the time of presentation in 125 patients with hydatidiform mole (HM), 43 with invasive mole (IM), and 34 with choriocarcinoma (CC). In HM serum levels of hCG and SP1 declined steadily from presentation to remission; when gestational age at the time of molar evacuation was shorter than 11 weeks, hCG declined to the normal range later than SP1 (57% patients), and when the age was longer--at the same rate as SP1 (26% patients) or earlier (17% patients). Serum levels of either marker were higher in IM than in HM and tended to increase, and in CC were either lower or higher than in IM. Treatment was followed by parallel decline of either marker, although SP1 declined to the normal range later than hCG in 12% of patients with IM and in 10% with CC. The hCG/SP1 ratios in normal pregnancy declined exponentially between the beginning and 23rd week of gestation and stayed level thereafter. The ratios calculated for the gestational age at the time of initial evacuation of the uterus or delivery were close to those of normal pregnancy in 80%, slightly increased in 20% of patients with spontaneously regressing HM, and markedly increased in 70% of patients with IM and in 74% of patients with CC. The ratios tended to increase during chemotherapy. An increase in the hCG/SP1 ratio seemed to be a characteristic sign of malignant change when compared with this ratio in normal pregnancy and hydatidiform mole. Determination of SP1 for monitoring therapy seemed redundant, and hPL assay was useful for discrimination between relapse and pregnancy.
abstract_ja: 正常妊娠の婦人675例の血清中ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)、特異的妊娠蛋白(SP1)、hPLを測定し、また胞状奇胎(HM)125例、侵入奇胎(IM)43例、絨毛癌(CC)34例の患者について受診時から経時的に測定した。胞状奇胎では、hCGとSP1の血清値は初診時から寛解まで着実に低下した。奇胎除去時の妊娠週数が11週未満の場合、hCGはSP1より遅れて正常範囲に低下した(患者の57%)。妊娠週数がそれより長い場合は、SP1と同じ速度で(26%)、または早く(17%)低下した。いずれのマーカーも侵入奇胎では胞状奇胎より高値であり、上昇傾向を示した。絨毛癌では侵入奇胎より低値または高値であった。治療に伴い、いずれのマーカーも平行して低下したが、SP1は侵入奇胎患者の12%、絨毛癌患者の10%においてhCGより遅れて正常範囲に低下した。正常妊娠におけるhCG/SP1比は妊娠0週から23週までの間に指数関数的に低下し、その後は一定であった。子宮の初回除去時または分娩時の妊娠週数で算出した比は、80%で正常妊娠に近く、自然退縮した胞状奇胎の20%でわずかに上昇し、侵入奇胎の70%および絨毛癌の74%で著明に上昇した。化学療法中には比が上昇する傾向があった。正常妊娠および胞状奇胎と比較して、hCG/SP1比の上昇は悪性変化の特徴的な徴候と考えられた。SP1による治療モニタリングは冗長に思われ、hPLの測定は再発と妊娠の鑑別に有用であった。
